name: E2B sandbox (code execution)
description: Hosted (or self-hostable) Firecracker sandbox for running agent-generated code, used through the E2B SDK.

provenance.notes: Supports version 2.56.0 of the e2b Python SDK (uploaded 2026-10-13). PyPI license_expression MIT; the repository root LICENSE is Apache-2.0, so no license block is asserted.
Supports billing_class metered: per-second CPU and RAM pricing; plan concurrency and session-length caps recorded in the note.
Supports E2B_API_KEY authentication and on-demand Linux VM sandbox description.

Supports Firecracker microVM isolation, per-sandbox egress firewall with domain allow/deny lists, and self-hosting (single host, Terraform for GCP/AWS/Azure). side_effect mutating is a project classification: executes arbitrary code, creates billable resources and may reach the network.
